audit_items.proof_trace: The `exchange_rate` function guards explicitly with `if (self.total_supply == 0) return from_quotient(1,1)` (L93), so the only division uses `float::from(self.total_supply)` as denominator which equals `total_supply * WAD > 0` when the guard passes. The numerator `cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves` cannot reach zero when `total_supply > 0`: it is strictly positive after the first mint and all subsequent operations (borrow/repay, interest accrual, take_revenue, flash loans, liquidations) either preserve or increase it, as confirmed by tracing the `withdraw_underlying` invariant `cash >= cash_reserve.ceil()` through every mutation path.
